transcript.en: Hello, all. Welcome to Aspen Ski Resort near Cumbria.
transcript.zh: 大家好。欢迎来到坎布里亚郡附近的阿斯彭滑雪场。

transcript.en: It is one of my favorite vacation spots.
transcript.zh: 这是我最喜欢的度假胜地之一。

transcript.en: I first discovered this fantastic resort when it was recommended to me by a journalist who was interviewing me.
transcript.zh: 我第一次发现这个奇妙的度假胜地是一位记者采访我时向我推荐的。

transcript.en: I then contacted my travel agent for further information about the resort and, from the first time I visited the place, it was “love at first sight”.
transcript.zh: 然后我联系了我的旅行社以获取有关度假村的更多信息，从我第一次来这个地方开始，我就对此地“一见钟情”。

transcript.en: Now, when I don’t have acting jobs to do, I would come here and relax.
transcript.zh: 现在，当我没有表演工作时，我会来这里放松一下。

transcript.en: My parents were both geographers and their profession afforded my siblings and I the opportunity to travel with them all over the world when we were growing up, visiting some of the places I had seen in the television documentaries I had watched.
transcript.zh: 我的父母都是地理学家，他们的职业使我和我的兄弟姐妹有机会在我们成长的过程中与他们一起环游世界，参观我看过的电视纪录片中的一些地方。

transcript.en: Their passion kept affecting me and eventually I realized that travelling has been something I love for a long time.
transcript.zh: 他们的热情一直影响着我，最终我意识到旅行一直是我的最爱。

transcript.en: A bit of background on the Aspen Ski Resort: The area of Cumbria was first known as a vacation spot in the 1920s, however that was only as a summer vacation spot.
transcript.zh: 阿斯彭滑雪场的一点背景知识：坎布里亚地区在20世纪20 年代最初被称为度假胜地，但那时只是作为夏季度假胜地。

transcript.en: The area became home to a summer resort in the 1930s.
transcript.zh: 到20世纪30年代成为避暑胜地。

transcript.en: In the 1960s, with the increasing popularity of downhill skiing, the first British ski resort appeared.
transcript.zh: 20世纪60年代，随着高山滑雪的日益普及，出现了英国第一个滑雪场。

transcript.en: The Aspen Ski Resort was established soon after in 1968 and the Cumbria area became a popular destination for winter skiing vacations.
transcript.zh: 很快，阿斯彭滑雪场于1968年成立了，坎布里亚地区成为冬季滑雪度假的热门目的地。

transcript.en: Although snow skiing is the most popular winter activity at the resort, there are also some other popular activities.
transcript.zh: 虽然滑雪是度假村最受欢迎的冬季活动，但也有一些其他受欢迎的活动。

transcript.en: In the spring, summer, and fall seasons, playing golf is easily the favorite activity of most of the resort’s guests.
transcript.zh: 在春季、夏季和秋季，大多数度假村客人很容易喜欢上打高尔夫球。

transcript.en: There are five top-ranked courses within a short driving distance of the resort and the resort offers many packages for visitors during the warmer months.
transcript.zh: 距离度假村不远的车程，有五个顶级球场，度假村在温度暖和的月份为游客提供许多高尔夫套餐。

transcript.en: Also, throughout the year, many of the resort’s guests like to visit the Great Waters Brewing Company.
transcript.zh: 此外，度假村的许多客人全年都喜欢参观大酿水公司。

transcript.en: But it is under reconstruction at the moment.
transcript.zh: 但它目前正在重建中。

transcript.en: Also, many of our visitors take advantage of skydiving activities offered by a skydiving school, but the school is located in another town which is about 2-hour drive from here.
transcript.zh: 另外，我们的许多客人都参加了跳伞学校提供的跳伞活动，不过，跳伞学校位于另一个距离这里约 2 小时车程的镇子。

transcript.en: Some people ask what activities are recommended in the nearby Edimore region.
transcript.zh: 有人问附近的埃迪莫尔地区有什么活动可以推荐。

transcript.en: Many visitors to that popular destination often also visit either the hot springs near the city of Marlborough or the local market in the city of Jameston.
transcript.zh: 许多前往该热门目的地的游客也经常去马尔堡市附近的温泉或詹姆士顿市的本地市场。

transcript.en: The hot springs are geothermally heated groundwaters that rise from the crust of the earth and are enjoyed by folks of all ages.
transcript.zh: 温泉是地热加热的地下水，从地壳中冒出来，老少皆宜。

transcript.en: However, the price of having a hot spa there is quite high this season.
transcript.zh: 不过这个季节泡温泉的价格还是蛮高的。

transcript.en: The Edimore Nature Museum is a great alternative.
transcript.zh: 埃迪莫尔自然博物馆是一个不错的选择。

transcript.en: You will see details of the animals which are native to the area.
transcript.zh: 您回看到该地区原生动物的详细信息。

transcript.en: Most visitors in the past gave really positive feedback about the museum.
transcript.zh: 去过的大多数参观者都对博物馆给予了非常积极的反馈。

transcript.en: The market in Jameston region has a nice selection of fruits and vegetables which are grown on farms in the area and also a selection of fresh seafood.
transcript.zh: 詹姆士顿地区的市场有许多本地农场种植的水果和蔬菜，还有各种新鲜海鲜。

transcript.en: The market is not open this week.
transcript.zh: 本周市场不开放。

transcript.en: Please note that the Aspen Resort sponsors monthly education and entertainment programs which are open to the public.
transcript.zh: 请注意，阿斯彭度假村赞助每月的教育和娱乐节目，这些节目都是向公众开放的。

transcript.en: Previous programs have featured Mountain Walking in Europe and Wildlife around the World.
transcript.zh: 以前的节目以欧洲的山间漫步和世界各地的野生动物为特色。

transcript.en: The upcoming entertainment program which will take place at 7 p.m. May 18th in the resort’s conference center will be about the Landscape of the United Kingdom.
transcript.zh: 即将在5 月 18 日晚上7点在度假村的会议中心举行的娱乐节目将介绍英国的风景。

transcript.en: These events are free to those attending, but seats are available on a first come, first served basis.
transcript.zh: 这些活动免费参加，但座位先到先得。

transcript.en: Finally, let me outline what some of the Cumbria area’s other skiing locations are popular for.
transcript.zh: 最后，让我概述一下坎布里亚地区其他一些滑雪地点受欢迎的方面。

transcript.en: Lakeside is the oldest of the area resorts.
transcript.zh: 湖畔是该地区最古老的度假村。

transcript.en: Its popularity barely decreases over the years and it was recently renovated.
transcript.zh: 它的受欢迎程度多年来都没有下降，并且最近进行了翻新。

transcript.en: A newly-built ski school there has attracted some attention and it will be open to the public within a couple of months.
transcript.zh: 那里一所新建的滑雪学校引起了大家关注，它将在几个月内向公众开放。

transcript.en: Petersburg is well-known as a training site for skiing teams.
transcript.zh: 圣彼得堡是著名的滑雪队训练基地。

transcript.en: It’s the home training base for Olympic champion Billy Randolph.
transcript.zh: 这里是奥运冠军比利·兰道夫的家庭训练基地。

transcript.en: Winterton is a resort that is well-known as a place for inexperienced skiers.
transcript.zh: 温特顿是一个以适合新手滑雪者而闻名的度假胜地。

transcript.en: It has many different bunny hills for new learners, and it doesn’t require any good equipment.
transcript.zh: 它有许多不同的初学者滑雪道供新手学习，并且不需要高端设备。

transcript.en: Al-slops is a resort that will provide you with some special service.
transcript.zh: Al-slops是一个能为您提供一些特殊的服务的度假村。

transcript.en: They have a certified staff that will care for your kids while you are on the slopes.
transcript.zh: 他们有经过认证的工作人员,会在您滑雪时照看您的孩子。

transcript.en: For people who want to enjoy the beauty of nature as well as having some exciting activities, these places are…
transcript.zh: 对于那些想享受大自然之美同时能参加一些令人兴奋的活动的人来说，这些地方是……
